options.label: F
options.text: In 1903 paved roads were rare in the United States, but they became more common after Jackson and Crocker drove across the country.

options.label: G
options.text: In 1903 Jackson and Crocker drove a car across the United States and found that cars had many problems.

options.text: In 1903 Jackson and Crocker drove a car across the United States, which was a great accomplishment at that time.
